items.question: On which hands must the ritual binding be placed for women and for other recipients?
premises: The binding is assigned to the left hand for women.
The binding is assigned to the right hand for others.
Hand placement of the binding differs by recipient category.
items.inference: Therefore the ritual binding is placed on different hands depending on whether the recipient is a woman or another person.
items.plain_english: For women, place the binding on the left hand; for others, place it on the right hand.
